# A generic (non-OneDrive) space works end to end through the CLI surface.
mkdir local
mkdir remote-files
exec sh -c 'printf "[nas]\ntype = alias\nremote = %s\n" "$1" > rclone.conf' sh $WORK/remote-files
chmod 0600 rclone.conf

exec drivebridge space-add --state $WORK/state --space nas --backend generic --remote nas --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
stdout 'Space configured'

exec drivebridge capabilities --state $WORK/state --json
stdout '"backend":"generic"'
stdout '"reference_handoff":false'
stdout '"direct_url":false'
stdout '"follow_symlinks":false'

# Re-adding with a different remote is a conflict, same as OneDrive spaces.
! exec drivebridge space-add --state $WORK/state --space nas --backend generic --remote other --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576

# The doctor preflight reports the generic backend; ffprobe degrades to info
# for a setup with no OneDrive space, so readiness holds either way.
exec drivebridge doctor --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf --json
stdout '"ready":true'
stdout 'generic rclone backend'
